title: Design System: ArrowFin CME Candle Chart

display.purpose: Page title and chart titles only.

mono.purpose: Session metadata, measurements, and chart timings.

shadows.name: paper-flat
shadows.purpose: Separation is carried by 1px rules, not raised shadows.

motion.name: guide-arrive
motion.purpose: Last-close guide and point appear with a brief, controlled transition; reduced motion makes it immediate.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Compact uppercase header mark for the ArrowFin trading record.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { color: #294235; text-decoration: none; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-wordmark span { color: #b94f35; }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: Readable web select for contract and timeframe choice.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #59685d; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field select { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 32px 0 11px; border: 1px solid #bcbcae; border-radius: 3px; background: #f8f6ef; color: #294235; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b94f35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Session stat tile for latest close, high, low, and volume.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width: 0; padding: 13px 15px 14px; border: 1px solid #d1cdbc; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8f6ef; } .ds-metric span { display: block; color: #59685d; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 7px; color: #294235; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 1.35rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 550; }

components.name: Chart Panel
components.description: Wide close-price chart framed like a worksheet panel with a thin-rule caption area.
components.css: .ds-chart-panel { margin: 0; padding: 21px 23px 13px; border: 1px solid #d1cdbc; border-radius: 4px; background: #f8f6ef; } .ds-chart-head { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-chart-head h2 { margin: 0; color: #294235; font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-chart-head p { margin-top: 5px; color: #59685d; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.69rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-legend { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #59685d; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-legend i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #496a50; display: inline-block; } .ds-chart { display: block; width: 100%; height: 220px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-chart polyline { fill: none; stroke: #496a50; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2.5; }

components.name: Retry Button
components.description: Error-recovery action with oxide emphasis and minimal framing.
components.css: .ds-retry { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #8d3926; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #8d3926; font: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-retry:hover { background: #f1ddd5; } .ds-retry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #b94f35; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This interface reads like a paper ledger for a synthetic market session: warm mineral paper, fir-green ink, and a single oxide accent that marks the active value under review. Loading, empty, and error states remain explicit, while the last close is presented as a measured point instead of a generic dashboard dot.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper field and fir-green ink form the default reading environment.
Oxide accent is reserved for active values, selections, and recovery actions.
The chart uses thin rules and monospaced numeric alignment to keep measurements precise.
The guide to the latest close is a functional measurement cue, not a decorative tooltip.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Use the warm paper field as the default surface and reserve oxide for selected points, active values, and direct action states; keep the overall interface flat and legible rather than glossy or ornamental.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Numeric precision is structural: times, prices, and session totals use tabular figures so the reading preserves alignment across candle counts and values.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep the evaluator's path short and explicit: query controls, summary metrics, then chart. The chart is the final authority, while the top bar and labels provide context rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain nearly flush: no broad shadows, no glossy overlays, no faux metal or dashboard chrome. The paper stock and the rule lines carry separation instead.

rules.name: The Guide Rule
rules.body: The last close is the active datum. Connect it visibly to its exact price label; the line should feel like a measurement, not a tooltip garnish.

dos: Do keep the warm paper field and fir-green ink as the default reading environment.
Do use oxide for the active point, selection state, and only the most important action cue.
Do keep loading, empty, and error states explicit and readable.
donts: Don't switch the system to glossy dashboard chrome, soft shadows, or generic neutral UI surfaces.
Don't use serif body copy or display typography as a general override; the world stays editorial only in headings.
Don't hide the synthetic backend state behind decorative language or vague status messaging.
